title: Autumn Jackpot Cash Bingo on Wednesday 30 September
preheader: Ten games, £10 cash per book, 7pm start. Reserve online, pay on the night.

data.heading: Cash Bingo, anyone?
body: Join us for Autumn Jackpot Cash Bingo. Bring your bingo friends for ten games and a final cash jackpot that grows with every book sold.
Reserve online, pay on the night. Bingo books cost £10 each, payable in cash when you arrive. No online payment is taken.

image.alt: Autumn Jackpot Cash Bingo at The Anchor

data.heading: About the Snowball
body: The poster shows a projected £160 Snowball for a full house within 56 numbers. This depends on it remaining unclaimed at earlier Cash Bingo nights.
To play for the Snowball, you must have attended at least one of the previous three Cash Bingo nights. This condition applies to the Snowball, not the final cash jackpot.

rows.label: Seating
rows.value: Communal tables, book your group together

data.heading: Everyone settled before eyes down
body: Numbers appear on the pub TVs, so beginners can follow along. Dabbers are available for £1 cash.
18+ to play. Supervised under-18s are welcome to attend but may not play. Include everyone attending in your booking.

data.body: Who’s joining you? Book your group together and we’ll get your seats ready.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
